description:
Update a webhook endpoint: its URL, events, scope, sub-accounts, status or description. Every field is optional, but send at least one. Changing the scope to "selected" without profile_ids keeps the stored list. The signing secret is unchanged (rotate it with rotate_webhook_endpoint_secret).

ACCESS: needs a Proof account. Set PROOF_API_KEY and restart this server, then call this tool again. start_login does NOT open this tool.

description.description: Your own label for the endpoint, at most 200 characters; null clears it

events.description: Subscription patterns (at most 32): an exact event type, a family wildcard such as "proof.*", or "*". An empty list means every event.

profile_ids.description: Sub-account ids, 24 hex characters each, at most 100. At least one when scope is "selected"; none when scope is "all".

scope.description: "all" serves every sub-account, present and future, plus account-level events; "selected" serves only the sub-accounts in profile_ids

url.description: HTTPS URL deliveries are sent to, at most 2000 characters. Private, loopback and link-local addresses are refused.

name: update_webhook_endpoint

legacy.description: The endpoint converted from the account's single webhook URL — the one the deprecated `/me/settings` webhook block reads and writes.

scope.description: `all` — every sub-account, present and future, plus account-level events. `selected` — only the sub-accounts in `profile_ids`; account-level events never reach it.

secret_set.description: Whether the endpoint has a signing secret (always true).

status.description: A `disabled` endpoint receives nothing; its history and secret are kept.

url.description: HTTPS URL deliveries are POSTed to, at most 2000 characters. Private, loopback and link-local addresses are refused.
